work.title: Symphony No. 7 in E major
work.movement: II. Adagio — Sehr feierlich und sehr langsam

version.note: Neither the Commons page, the IMSLP performance entry, the embedded tags nor the Munich analysis page names the edition performed (Gutmann 1885, Haas, Nowak or Cohrs). The 1885 first edition is cited only as a viewable public-domain score for the orchestration timeline. Whether the cymbal-and-triangle clash at the climax is played is not established from the sources; the audio analysis cannot decide it.

performers.note: The IMSLP performance entry gives “Hochschulsymphonieorchester (Munich), Marcus Bosch (conductor)”, the MP3’s embedded artist tag reads “Hochschulsymphonieorchester (München), Ltg. Marcus Bosch”, and the Munich analysis page repeats the credit. The Commons page credits only “University of Music and Theatre Munich” as author. No roster of players is given.

date.value: 2020 (credits) or 8 November 2021 (inferred from file names and a programme listing)
date.note: The credits (IMSLP: “Live recording at the University of Music and Theatre Munich 2020”; embedded date tag; Commons; Munich analysis page) give 2020. The IMSLP file names, however, carry the token 2021-11-08, and the Gasteig November 2021 programme lists a Hochschulsymphonieorchester München concert under Marcus Bosch with Bruckner’s Seventh at the Isarphilharmonie, 19:00, under Mo 08. That matching concert is an inferred association, not proof that the files were cut from it; neither date is promoted to a settled session date, and no day or month is documented in the credits.

alternatives.value: 2020 (year only; credit on IMSLP, Commons, the embedded tags and the Munich analysis page)
8 November 2021 (inferred from the IMSLP file-name token 2021-11-08 and the Gasteig programme listing)

place.value: University of Music and Theatre Munich (Hochschule für Musik und Theater München); the hall is not named in the credits
place.note: IMSLP’s miscellaneous note and the embedded comment (“Live-Konzertmitschnitt der Hochschule für Musik und Theater München 2020”) name the institution as the place of the live recording, not a hall. The Gasteig programme lists a concert with the same forces at the Isarphilharmonie; whether the recording was made there is not established.

label.value: University of Music and Theatre Munich (IMSLP publisher information); no commercial label
label.note: IMSLP’s publisher field reads “University of Music and Theatre Munich, 2020”. The file is a concert recording distributed through IMSLP and Wikimedia Commons, not a label release.

catalogue.value: IMSLP recording #899191; file PMLP7929-2021-11-08 HP8 HSO Bruckner-7 02.mp3
catalogue.note: This is IMSLP’s own identifier for the file, not a label catalogue number.

matrixTakeSides.note: A live concert capture distributed as an MP3 file has no disc matrix, take or side. This is not a statement about the original recording medium.

credits.note: IMSLP names the uploader of the file (Musikisum, 11 February 2024) and the Commons file page lists the University as author; neither identifies a recording, editing or mastering engineer. An uploader is not treated as a transfer engineer.

date.note: The IMSLP upload date (11 February 2024) and the Commons revision dates are not transfer or session dates.

processing.value: MP3 file, about 128 kbit/s, 1075.652 s, with embedded ID3 tags; hosted unchanged on Wikimedia Commons as an MP3 original.
processing.note: The bit rate and tags were read from the cached copy with ffprobe; the Commons media record gives the duration and MP3 type. No restoration, editing or loudness processing is disclosed.

digital.format: MP3 original file hosted by Wikimedia Commons

composition.value: Public domain; Commons tags the composition PD-old-auto-expired (Bruckner died in 1896).
composition.note: The notice concerns the composition only. It does not license a modern critical edition or this recording.

recording.value: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International. Rights rule 1: the licence covers the sound recording.
recording.note: The Commons Copyright information template gives recording = CC BY-SA 4.0, the IMSLP performance entry states Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0, the embedded copyright tag reads CC BY-SA 4.0, and the Munich analysis page states the licence for the same recording with a rights-holder attribution pattern. The licence is that of the University of Music and Theatre Munich’s recording and is separate from the composition’s public-domain tag.
